Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting victim data and demanding ransom payments
Psychological manipulation via holiday-themed ransom notes
Offering discounts to entice victims to pay ransom
Threatening to publish stolen data if ransom not paid
Impacted Systems: Victims of Sodinokibi/REvil and Maze ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Holiday ransom notes with messages wishing Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays
25% discount offer from Maze operators between December 25th and 31st
Discounted ransom demand of $500,000 for City of Pensacola by Maze
Threats to publish or delete stolen data depending on ransom payment
